reading: TWO OTHER AI RATERS AGREE WITH THE GRADER (still provisional: not a human check)

disagreements.gpt_why: Mentions advertising controls without establishing an option to disable targeted advertising.
disagreements.fable_why: Says you can control how data is used to show ads via tools.

disagreements.gpt_why: Message contents may be processed to comply with legal obligations, establishing access.
disagreements.fable_why: Message content you send and receive is listed among information processed.

disagreements.gpt_why: Users choose whether to share profile information and other data with partners.
disagreements.fable_why: About sharing account data with partner apps, not controlling content audience.

disagreements.gpt_why: Severability applies only to the arbitration agreement, not the Terms of Service generally.
disagreements.fable_why: Severability stated only for the Arbitration Agreement, not the whole Terms.

disagreements.gpt_why: References unspecified US states without identifying California or claiming CCPA compliance.
disagreements.fable_why: Mentions certain US states and opt-out signals, not CCPA or California.

disagreements.gpt_why: Explicitly removes content promoting sexual violence and threatening or advocating rape.
disagreements.fable_why: Removes content that depicts, threatens or promotes sexual violence.

disagreements.gpt_why: Mentions advertising settings without establishing that users can opt out of personalized advertising.
disagreements.fable_why: Says you can control data use for personalised advertising and amend settings.

disagreements.gpt_why: Mentions a Last Updated field but supplies no actual update date.
disagreements.fable_why: States a Last Updated date sits at the top of the policy.

disagreements.gpt_why: Shares identifiable user data with Meta companies for business analytics beyond core messaging operations.
disagreements.fable_why: Recipients are Meta companies providing hosting, analytics and authentication services.

disagreements.gpt_why: Describes targeted advertising without establishing personal data sharing with advertising companies.
disagreements.fable_why: Uses your information for interest-based, retargeted and behavioral advertising.

disagreements.gpt_why: Explicitly uses collected information to personalize advertisements.
disagreements.fable_why: Describes personalising products and ads, not marketing communications to you.
